    [9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9]
]

# Apply rule: if row is odd and grid[row][1] == 9, change to 3
output = []
for i, row in enumerate(grid):
    new_row = list(row)
    if i % 2 == 1 and new_row[1] == 9:
        new_row[1] = 3
    output.append(new_row)

print(json.dumps(output))
